spans.s: कुटः [kuṭḥ] टम् [ṭam], टम् [कुट्-कम्] A water pot, a jar, pitcher.
N. of Droṇa. -हारिका, -कारिका a female servant, Hch.
कुटकम् [kuṭakam], A plough without a pole. -कः The post round which the string of the churning-stick passes. (pl.) N. of a people; कोङ्कवेङ्ककुटकानां राजा
कुटङ्गकः [kuṭaṅgakḥ], 1 An armour formed by creeping plants overrunning a tree.
A small house, hut or cottage.
कुटपः [kuṭapḥ], 1 A measure of grain (= कुडव).
A sage, an ascetic. -पम् A lotus.
कुटरः [kuṭarḥ], The post round which the rope of the churning-stick passes.
कुटिक [kuṭika] त [t], त a. Bent, crooked.
कुटिकम् [kuṭikam], A village under one head-man; एको ग्रामणिको यत्र सभृत्यपरिचारकः । कुटिकं तद्विजानीयादेकभोगः स एव तु Kāmikāgama 2.4.
; bent, curved, curled; भेदाद् भ्रुवोः कुटिलयोः Ś.5.23;
Tortuous, winding; क्रोशं कुटिला नदी Sk.
लम् N. of a plant (Mar. तगर).
Tin. -Comp. -आशय a. evil-minded; malevolent; संध्यावत्क्षणरागिण्यो नदीवत्कुटिलाशयाः

कुटिलिका [kuṭilikā], 1 Coming stealthily as a hunter on his prey, crouching.
A cottage, hut; प्रासादीयति कुट्याम् Sk.;
A vessel with openings used for fumigation.
A bower (लतागृह); कुटीषु गोपीरुचि- रासु यो$र्कभूतटीषु गोपाल
.-Comp. -चकः a religious mendicant of a particular order; चतुर्विधाभिक्षवस्ते कुटीचकबहूदकौ । हंसः परमहंसश्च यो यः पश्चात् स उत्तमः ॥ Mb.;
. -चरः a kind of ascetic who entrusts the care of his family to his son and devotes himself solely to religious penance and austerities.
कुटीरः [kuṭīrḥ] रम् [ram] कुटीरकः [kuṭīrakḥ], रम् कुटीरकः [कुटीशमीशुण्डाभ्यो रः
कुटुङ्गकः [kuṭuṅgakḥ], 1 An arbour formed by creeping plants.
कुटुनी [kuṭunī], A bawd, procuress; see कुट्टनी.
कुटुम्ब [kuṭumba] कुटुम्बकम् [kuṭumbakam], कुटुम्बकम् A household, a family; परमियं ब्राह्मणी अस्मिन् कुटुम्बे Mbh. on
The duties and cares of a family; तदु- पहितकुटुम्बः
N. of the second astrological mansion (अर्थ).
वः, वम् A kinsman, a relation by descent or marriage.

. -भूमिः the site where a house is built; कुटुम्बभूमिमानं तु वाटक्षेत्रविवर्जितम् Kāmikāgama 21.3. -व्यापृत a. (a father) who is provident and attentive to the good of the family.
A householder, married man, (a pater familias,) one who has a family to support or take care of; प्रायेण गृहिणीनेत्राः कन्यार्थेषु कुटुम्बिनः
(fig.) One who takes care of anything.
नी The wife of a householder, a house-wife (in charge of the house); द्रव्योपकरणं सर्वं नान्ववैक्षत्कुटुम्बिनी
; प्रभ- वन्त्यो$पि हि भर्तुषु कारणकोपाः कुटुम्बिन्यः

A female servant of a house.
कुटुम्बिता [kuṭumbitā] त्वम् [tvam], त्वम् 1 The state of being a householder.
P. (कुट्यति) To break to pieces, break asunder, divide, split;
To abstain from giving, not to give.
कुट्ट [kuṭṭa], a. (At the end of comp.) Dividing, cutting; grinding; -ट्टः (in Math.) A multiplier.
कुट्ट [kuṭṭa] ट्टि [ṭṭi] नी [nī], (ट्टि) नी A bawd, procuress, a go-between. ...पार्श्वे तथैव प्रतिवसति महाकुट्टनी खङ्गयष्टिः

Falsehood, untruth; oft. used in comp. with the force of an adjective; ˚वचनम् false or deceitful words; ˚तुला, ˚मानम् &c.
A summit or peak of a mountain; वर्धयन्निव तत्कूटानु- द्धतैर्धातुरेणुभिः
The bone of the forehead with its projections, the crown of the head.
A heap, mass, multitude; अभ्रकूटम् 'a heap of clouds'; so अन्नकूटम् 'a heap of food';
A plough-share, the body of a plough.
A trap for catching deer; नश्येदभिमृशन्सद्यो मृगः कूट- मिव स्पृशन्
A concealed weapon, as a dagger in a woollen case or a sword in a stick.
The door of a city; निर्ययुर्भवनात्त- स्मात्कूटमुद्गरपाणयः
A false coin; कूटं हि निषादानामेवोपकारकं न आर्याणाम् ŚB. on
An ox whose horns are broken.

a man of the writer caste (कायस्थ).

कुट्टमितम् [kuṭṭamitam], The affected repulse of a lover's endearments or caresses (one of the 28 graces or blandishments of the heroine). The S. D. thus defines it: केशस्तनाधरादीनां ग्रहे हर्षे$पि संभ्रमात् । प्राहुः कुट्टमितं नाम शिरःकरविधूननम् 142.
कुट्टाक [kuṭṭāka], a. (-कि f.) Who or what divides or cuts; सारङ्गसंगरविधाविभकुम्भकूटाकुट्टाकपाणिकुलिशस्य हरेः प्रमादः
कूटक [kūṭaka], a. Fraudulent, false, base (as a coin);
The body of a plough, a plough-share.
कः A braid or trees of hair.
A perfume.-Comp. -आख्यानम् an invented tale; a tale containing passages of ambiguous meanings.
Pounded &c. -ता Unskilful opening of a vein.
कुट्टिम [kuṭṭima], a. Paved with small stones, decorated with mosaic.

Ground prepared for the site of a mansion.
कुट्टिहारिका [kuṭṭihārikā], A maid-servant, slave; cf. कुटहारिका.
कूटशः [kūṭaśḥ], ind. In heaps or multitudes.
